facts.text: John's teammates signed a basketball to show their friendship and appreciation for him.

evidence.quote: Check out this photo of what my teammates gave me when we met. It's a sign of our friendship and all the love we have for each other.

facts.text: John finds comfort in having a basketball signed by his teammates as a reminder of his bond with them and his motivation to play basketball.
